label: People by Domains

headings.className: section-header-label section-header-label--rule block! border-b pb-3 text-c-1 responses-title--tree mt-3 mb-0 block! leading-[1.45] font-medium

paragraphs: Find people at companies by their domains. How it works: Provide a list of company domains (up to 1000) and job titles to search for The system finds companies by domains Returns up to people_per_company people per found company with matching job titles Job title matching: Uses semantic search: "Head of Sales" will match "VP Sales", "Sales Director", etc. Multiple job titles are combined with OR logic Parameters: people_per_company: Number of people to return per company (1-1000, default: 1) Limits: Maximum 1000 domains per request Maximum 20 job titles per request Maximum 1000 people per company Maximum 10000 people per response (total) Billing: 1 credit per person returned Deduplication: Pass dedup list ids in exclude_lists — matched people are not returned and not charged
Find people at companies by their domains.

parameters.name: domains
parameters.description: List of company domains (max 1000). Each domain will be normalized.

parameters.name: job_titles
parameters.description: Job titles to search for (max 20, OR logic). Supports semantic matching.

parameters.name: exclude_lists
parameters.description: Ids of your dedup lists (see Deduplication endpoints). Results already present in these lists are excluded and never charged. When set, the free results zone does not apply. Max 100 lists / 500000 values combined per request.

parameters.name: people_per_company
parameters.description: Number of people to return per company (1-1000). Default: 1.
